Elle additionne les taxes du marché sans: It adds up the market taxes without ever getting a carry wrong. The tax collector finally goes home for dinner.
Tout nombre s'y écrit avec deux signes s: Any number can be written on it with only two signs. Students find it long-winded, until the day a machine does it for them.
Le motif du tissu est troué dans des car: The fabric's pattern is punched into cards that the machine reads by itself. You change the design by changing the card.
D'un côté on calcule, de l'autre on gard: On one side you calculate, on the other you keep the numbers. It only exists on plans so far, and the factory has set a bay aside for it.
On y écrit, pas à pas, ce que la machine: In it, step by step, you write what the machine will have to do before it even exists. Someone saw in it that the machine could compose music.
Des interrupteurs qui disent « et », « o: Switches that say "and", "or", "not". The island's network is now controlled by logic.
La machine garde sa recette dans la même: The machine keeps its recipe in the same memory as its numbers. You can change it in a minute, without rewiring.
Elle apprend aux machines à lire des mot: She teaches machines to read words, so that sailors can talk to them without numbers. A moth is taped into her logbook.
